title: Return supported when exact verification evidence satisfies the stored precondition

items.request.can-erase-fourth-disk: The caller asks whether the fourth disk may now be erased and added to tank
items.scope.n5-migration: The request is scoped to the N5 migration
items.time.as-of-request: The caller supplies the decision time
items.rule.read-only-no-world-action: The translation layer can answer but cannot erase a disk or alter a pool
items.query.resolve-and-evaluate: A bounded request for identity and every destructive precondition
items.store.topology.current: Current topology shows the disk outside tank
items.store.disk-role.independent-source: The disk is the independent migration source
items.store.safety.verify-before-erase: The destructive precondition requires successful retained verification evidence
items.store.verification.method-qualifies: The recorded verification method covers byte content for the intended source and target
items.store.verification.scope-exact: The recorded verification scope matches the identified source and target
items.store.verification.exit-success: A successful exit result was retained
items.store.currentness.topology: The topology evidence has an explicit observation time and acceptable freshness standing
items.store.source.topology: A source pointer for current topology and disk role
items.store.source.copy: A source pointer for the completed copy state
items.store.source.verification: A source pointer for verification method, scope, output, and exit result
items.store.risk.remaining-expansion: The remaining operational risk after the evidence precondition is met
items.coverage.all-preconditions-complete: Identity, topology, copy, rule, verification, and sources were completely retrieved
items.meaning.preconditions-supported: The layer finds every stored precondition supported by exact evidence
items.response.erase-supported-no-action: The caller receives supported with citations, remaining risks, and no-action notice
items.durable.generated-safety-answer: The generated answer was stored as canonical knowledge
items.world.disk-added-to-tank: The fourth disk was added to tank

steps.note: Request identity and every category needed by the destructive precondition
Return unique identities and complete, exact precondition evidence
Compare exact evidence with the stored precondition and find each element supported
Return supported with the evidence chain while performing no erase or pool mutation
